subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this locked, pinned PR-limit announcement remain open now that the 20-PR policy is documented and enforced?
rationale: Current main and the latest release already implement the policy in docs and automation, but the issue was explicitly reopened and pinned after that change and is labeled for maintainer/product review.

options.title: Keep as policy notice
options.body: Leave the issue open, locked, and pinned as the visible GitHub announcement while CONTRIBUTING.md remains the canonical source.

options.title: Close as documented policy
options.body: Close the issue with a short note pointing contributors to CONTRIBUTING.md and the existing #clawtributors exception path.

options.title: Replace with another announcement surface
options.body: Move the announcement to a discussion or docs page and close this issue only after that replacement is visible.

recommendation.title: Keep as policy notice
recommendation.body: Leave the issue open, locked, and pinned as the visible GitHub announcement while CONTRIBUTING.md remains the canonical source.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the later rename, pin, reopen, and docs alignment for the 20-PR policy.
